units: <cite ref="Moed Katan 6b:8">M. Kat. 6ᵇ</cite> <he>אפלא וקא משוי לה וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>א׳ קא</he>, diff. vers. in Rashi) it is a slowly growing garden and by watering he makes it fast growing.—Pl. m. <he>אֲפֵילֵי</he>, <cite ref="Q01037"><he>אַפְלֵי</he></cite>.
Targ. Koh. XI, 2 late seeds.
<cite ref="Taanit 3b">Taan. 3ᵇ</cite> <he>אפילי</he> late clouds (after the rain), v. <cite ref="H01742"><he>חָרְפָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Niddah 65b:6">Nidd. 65ᵇ</cite> <he>חרפי ואפלי</he> earlier and later crops (in two succeeding years, so that the interval of time varies). Pl. f. <he>אֲפֵילָתָא</he>, <he>אַפְלָתָא</he>.
R. Hash. 8ᵃ late conceiving, sluggish sheep, opp. חָרְפְּיָיתָא.
